info.description:
Server-to-server API that LavBench uses to run competition workspaces on nano-colab.

## Authentication
Every call except the signed storage links sends `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Keys look like
`ncak_<key id>_<secret>`, are issued per client and live only in the LavBench backend. nano-colab stores
only their SHA-256. Each operation lists the scope it needs in `x-required-scope`. A missing or unknown key
gets 401; a key without the scope gets 403. Browsers never call this API.

## Typical flow
1. `GET /v1/images` to choose an `image_id`.
2. Upload the task package: `POST /v1/assets/{version}/uploads`, PUT the ZIP to the returned URL,
   `POST /v1/assets/{version}/complete`, then poll `GET /v1/assets/{version}` until `READY`.
3. `PUT /v1/events/{external_id}` with the stage's schedule and profile. Repeat it with `published: true` to
   publish, and repeat it again whenever LavBench changes the stage. LavBench timing is the source of truth.
4. Poll `GET /v1/events/{external_id}/readiness` until `READY`.
5. When a competitor opens their environment: `PUT /v1/events/{external_id}/workspaces/{external_user_id}`,
   then `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/launch`, and hand the token to that competitor's browser.
6. To collect submissions: `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/export` for the declared paths.

## Conventions
- IDs are deterministic. Every PUT is an idempotent upsert, so a timed-out request can be repeated as-is.
- Times are ISO 8601 and must include a timezone.
- Errors return `{"detail": ...}`. 409 and 503 responses may carry `Retry-After` (seconds); wait at least
  that long before retrying. Other 4xx errors will not succeed on retry.
- Launch tokens, upload URLs and exported file contents are secrets or student data: do not log them.

put.description: Idempotent upsert keyed by the client's own event ID. Returns 201 when the event is created and 200 otherwise; repeating the same request is safe. Drafts can change freely. Setting published=true publishes the event, which cannot be undone. After that only name, export_paths and a later end time may change, and moving the end records an extension. Publishing or extending an event can be refused when it would exceed approved capacity.

403.description: The API key lacks the events:write scope

409.description: Conflicting change: a frozen field changed after publication, an attempt to unpublish, a capacity refusal, or a task package owned by another client

Each file has its SHA-256 and every export is audited. Files over the size limit come back as TOO_LARGE without content.
